title: Kővári–Sós–Turán: Zarankiewicz integer counting form (formalize-only)
why_not_classical: Kővári–Sós–Turán 1954 Zarankiewicz counting lemma is settled: a bipartite graph with no K_{s,t} (s-side in α, t-side in β) satisfies ∑_b binom(deg b, s) ≤ (t-1) binom(|α|, s). Completely classical. Exact Zarankiewicz numbers z(m,n;s,t) are OPEN for most parameters and are OUT OF SCOPE — pinning the integer counting form is not a novelty claim and not an attack on Zarankiewicz. Value is a Mathlib contribution (SimpleGraph / completeBipartiteGraph / neighborFinset / Nat.choose exist; Turán's theorem exists as a DIFFERENT already-upstream clique-free theorem; ZERO KST / Zarankiewicz ident in Mathlib+Archive). Do NOT re-fund as novel. Mantel is a Turán corollary (upstream). Sunflower / Kruskal–Katona / Oddtown / EKR are different set-system theorems (ProofLab already has them).

statement_pin_required.convention: G : SimpleGraph (α ⊕ β), IsBipartiteSum (no internal edges). NoKst G s t = every s-set in α has ≤ t-1 common neighbours in β. Claim: 1 ≤ s → 1 ≤ t → ∑ b : β, Nat.choose (G.degree (.inr b)) s ≤ (t-1) * Nat.choose (Fintype.card α) s. Level A may land s=t=2 / empty / edgeless, not labelled KST.

statement_pin_required.canonical_source: T. Kővári, V. T. Sós, and P. Turán, On a problem of K. Zarankiewicz, Colloquium Mathematicum 3 (1954) 50–57. Textbook: Bollobás, Extremal Graph Theory; Jukna, Extremal Combinatorics (double counting). Type pin: SimpleGraph (α ⊕ β) + IsBipartiteSum + NoKst. Turán / Mantel / sunflower / exact Zarankiewicz are different statements, not this claim.

feasibility_shape: Level A: s=t=2 counting (no K_{2,2}/C4 between parts) + empty/edgeless landmines, zero sorry, not labelled KST. Optional cheap e² Cauchy–Schwarz corollary, not labelled KST. Level B: theorem kovari_sos_turan by double counting pairs (S,b) with S ⊆ N(b) ∩ α, |S|=s. Cap two levels. No real-exponent / Turán / exact Zarankiewicz.
